label: r1c1-desert-wide
motion: Hold near-still with steady sun flare for two seconds. Slow push in from low angle. Both camels continue forward. Husband walks his camel by the lead rope at a deliberate distance, gap between them maintained not closing. Harsh desert heat shimmer. No dialogue.

label: r1c2-camel-mouth
motion: Hold on closed-mouth tension two seconds. Lips draw back, mouth opens fully testing for water, tongue and teeth visible, then closes slowly unsatisfied. Shallow focus, heat-blurred background. No water enters frame.

label: r1c3-family-watching
motion: Group stands still. Husband's eyes drift toward the running purple figure not at the wife. Two adults beside him exchange a brief glance with each other not with her, as if they have seen this before, then look away. Purple runner exits frame. Subtle handheld drift.

label: r2c1-door-lock
motion: She works the padlock alone, hand steady. Family group visible at distance behind her, none stepping closer. Lock gives, her hand pauses a full beat before pushing the door. Low slow push toward her hand on the lock.

label: r2c2-under-bed-feet
motion: Both pairs of feet motionless facing forward two seconds. Both pairs pivot slowly to turn and face each other, weight shifting, held stillness once turned. Stolen unsteady framing, no faces.

label: r2c3-hospital-bed
motion: Hold on her resting expression, hand on belly. Slow push in. Ceiling fan turning steadily. Light shifts slightly across blinds. Warm hospital, not cold clinical.

label: r3c1-camel-neck
motion: Completely still three seconds. Muscle under skin tightens in visible ripple. Attempted release that does not fully complete, constriction holds. One continuous take, slow dolly in, faint pulse under fur.

label: r3c2-bedside-husband
motion: His hand raised, not yet touching hers. Distance closes a beat slower than it should. His eyes drop to their hands right as they meet. Static medium close, warm window light.

label: r3c3-oasis-mirage
motion: Continuous slow push toward distant water. Distance never closes. Heat shimmer builds across the full frame. No cut, no arrival. Wife leads camel by rope.
